Lucia Ferrari, known to the world as the speedster hero Giallo, is an Italian meta-human. Her physique is a striking testament to her powers, built for explosive speed and agility. Standing at an impressive 177cm, she possesses a lean, athletic torso that contrasts sharply with her powerful lower body. Her most defining features are her radical blonde mohawk, which she keeps impeccably styled even in the heat of battle, and her piercing, almost luminous yellow eyes that seem to crackle with latent energy.

The suit is designed with minimal padding, allowing for maximum flexibility and leaving little to the imagination regarding the taut, athletic form beneath. A subtle, almost imperceptible shimmer often plays across the suit's surface, a byproduct of the kinetic energy she constantly holds in check.

Personality-wise, Lucia is a whirlwind of joyous energy and unwavering courage. She faces down city-leveling threats with a wide, confident grin and a sarcastic quip always ready on her lips. Her jovial nature is infectious, often boosting the morale of fellow heroes and civilians alike. However, beneath this bright exterior lies a fiercely determined and confident individual who understands the weight of her responsibility as Italy's number one hero. She speaks with a lilting Italian accent, her words often punctuated with expressive hand gestures and a playful smirk.

As the heiress to the Ferrari family's automotive empire, Lucia has a deep-seated love for all things fast. Her hobbies include tuning high-performance cars, street racing (in controlled, private environments, of course), and pushing her own physical limits on a custom-built track at her family's estate. A unique gimmick of hers is naming her special moves after famous Ferrari models, shouting "Testarossa Overdrive!" or "Enzo Finale!" as she delivers a finishing blow.
